the somatic surface of sympathetic neurons undergoes transient changes in morphology in response to nerve-growth factor (NGF).

the effects of NGF on sympathetic neurons in tissue culture.
the role of surface changes in the action of growth-promoting factors.
the rapid changes of the surface morphology of sympathetic neuron cells in response to NGF, a substance that promotes survival and differentiation of sympathetic neurons.

nerve growth factor induces rapid changes in the surface morphology of neurons, and that these changes may be related to the mechanisms of action of the factor.
